# Witnesses for Gal(f_p/Q) = S_p,  f_p = x(x-1)...(x-p+1)+1.
# Rows 'p q': q is the least odd prime q < p with (disc f_p / q) = -1.
# Verify a row independently: reduce f_p mod q via
#   f_p = (x^q-x)^floor(p/q) * prod_{k < p mod q} (x-k) + 1  in F_q[x],
# compute D = (-1)^((p-1)/2) Res(f_p', f_p) mod q by the Euclidean
# algorithm, and check D^((q-1)/2) = -1 mod q.  By the certificate
# theorem this proves Gal(f_p/Q) = S_p.
# Exception: p = 5 has no such q; the listed q = 19 is a strict witness
# (f_5 mod 19 = irreducible quadratic times irreducible cubic).
# 9590 rows, covering every odd prime 5 <= p < 10^5.
